gen-gf-turret-road-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads as a plain sans with geometric poise, its counters breathing open and every glyph drawn as one ribbon. Turret Road above it is the loud one.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps its curves generous and its look contemporary. Underdog's heavy, horseshoe-shaped display letters hold their weight on every curve, while this sans-serif body stays light enough to read comfortably down a whole column.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-chillax: Chillax loops and lifts like spaghetti laid out in letters, casual and relaxed. Underdog, expressive and commanding on top, gives that loose body line something firm to lean on.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-plein: Plein leads each round letter in through a clear channel, reliable and clean. Underdog is the one for bent-paperclip display strokes with no swelling, while Plein does the quiet, steady work of the sans-serif text.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-spline-sans: Approachable and contemporary, Spline Sans leaves wide gaps between its curve ends and stems. Underdog's commanding horseshoe shapes make the sharpest difference, a display voice set against a friendly sans.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-synonym: Bold horseshoe curves up top, then a plain stripe of constant ink below in Synonym, generous in every opening. A long stretch of this sans-serif body would read clean and dependable.
gen-gf-underdog-outfit: Cable-bent curves and wide-open display shapes make Underdog and Outfit look cut from one wire, though one shouts and one speaks. Give Outfit a comfortable text size, and let it carry the plain sans work.
gen-gf-underdog-sora: Precise and geometric, Sora lets its c and s stay widely parted, with no pressure swell at the corners. And Underdog's expressive, commanding display weight gives the pair its strongest quality, a loud voice over a measured one.
gen-gf-underdog-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk brings a plain sans of neutral, geometric build, its counters breathing open and each glyph a ribbon of constant width. Underdog's commanding horseshoe letters are the draw.
gen-megrim-manrope: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters at one measured thickness, with a skyward x-height line. And Manrope, approachable and clean, gives them a bright, open sans-serif partner, which is the pair's real strength.
